jobs.description:
Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance
 At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.

Innovate with Tether
 Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT , relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.
 But that’s just the beginning:
 Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.
 Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET , our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.
 Tether Education : Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.
 Tether Evolution : At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

Why Join Us?
 Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.
 If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.
 Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job
 As a member of the AI model team, you will drive innovation in training and optimizing vision-language models with a focus on real-world deployment. Your work will span the full model development lifecycle - from data curation and training pipeline design to model evaluation and optimization - with the goal of building models that are both highly capable and practical to deploy at scale.
 You will work across a wide spectrum of multimodal architectures integrating text and vision, applying state-of-the-art research to improve model quality, efficiency, and domain-specific performance. We expect you to bring a research-driven mindset combined with strong engineering discipline - someone who can identify the right technique for a given problem, implement it rigorously, and measure its impact clearly.
 You will work closely with a small, high-caliber team where your contributions will have direct and meaningful impact. If you are passionate about pushing the boundaries of what multimodal AI can achieve in production environments, this is your opportunity.

Responsibilities

• Conduct end-to-end research and engineering on vision-language models, covering training, evaluation, and optimization across the full model development lifecycle.

• Design and implement post-training pipelines including supervised fine-tuning, knowledge distillation, and reinforcement learning from human feedback.

• Develop and maintain high-quality multimodal datasets, including data curation, filtering, and balancing for domain-specific tasks.

• Drive model efficiency and deployability, adapting models for resource-constrained environments using compression and optimization techniques.

• Design and implement evaluation frameworks and benchmarks to measure model performance, robustness, and real-world task success.

• Build and scale training workflows across distributed GPU infrastructure.

• Identify and resolve bottlenecks in training pipelines to achieve state-of-the-art model quality on target benchmarks.

• Contribute to and leverage open-source ecosystems including models, datasets, and tooling to accelerate development.

• Stay current with the latest research in multimodal learning and vision-language systems, translating relevant findings into practical improvements.

• Publish research findings in top-tier AI conferences and journals where applicable.

• Degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or a related field; MS/PhD preferred.

• Strong experience with multimodal post-training workflows including supervised fine-tuning, knowledge distillation, and reinforcement learning from feedback.

• Hands-on experience with parameter-efficient fine-tuning and distributed training frameworks.

• Demonstrated ability to build and improve vision-language models with measurable results on standard benchmarks or real-world tasks.

• Experience adapting models for resource-constrained environments.

• Proven open-source contributions in multimodal AI on GitHub or HuggingFace.

• Publications at top AI conferences (NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, CVPR, ECCV etc.)

Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

• Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/

• Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

• Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.

• Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ tether.to or @ tether.io

• We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

About the job
 As a member of our AI research team, you will drive innovation in model compression and efficient deployment for advanced multimodal AI systems, including large language models (LLMs) and vision-language models (VLMs). Your work will focus on reducing model footprint and computational cost while preserving accuracy, enabling high-performance AI to run efficiently across resource-constrained edge devices. You will apply and advance compression techniques such as quantization, knowledge distillation, and pruning to streamline complex multimodal architectures that integrate text, images, and audio.
 We expect you to have deep expertise in model compression methods and a strong background in multimodal model architectures. You will adopt a hands-on, research-driven approach to develop, test, and implement novel compression strategies that balance model size, latency, throughput, and accuracy. Your responsibilities include building robust compression pipelines, establishing performance and fidelity metrics, and addressing bottlenecks in production inference. The ultimate goal is to deliver scalable, low-memory, low-latency AI systems on edge devices (i.e., smartphones) that maintain high fidelity and tangible real-world value.

Responsibilities
 Break down the key responsibilities in bullet points. It’s helpful to make them actionable and measurable. This could also be grouped into categories for more complex roles.

• Apply low-bit quantization to reduce model size and inference latency for generative AI models (LLMs, VLMs, multimodal) while maintaining accuracy and output quality.

• Leverage knowledge distillation to transfer capabilities from larger teacher models to smaller student models, enabling efficient multimodal reasoning across text, image, and audio inputs.

• Implement pruning techniques to remove redundant parameters and attention heads, reducing computational overhead without sacrificing task performance.

• Analyze trade-offs between model efficiency (size, latency, memory) and accuracy across quantization, distillation, and pruning methods; propose improvements based on empirical findings.

• Research and apply mixed-precision quantization and other advanced compression strategies (e.g., adaptive pruning schedules, distillation with intermediate feature matching) to optimize the accuracy–performance balance.

• Stay current with the latest research in model compression, including emerging techniques for multimodal and generative architectures.

• Document methodologies, experiments, and results clearly to support reproducibility, internal collaboration, and stakeholder communication.

• Author technical papers and publish findings in top-tier conferences (e.g., NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, CVPR, ACL, AAAI) to advance the field of model compression for multimodal AI.

• A degree in Computer Science or related field. Ideally PhD in NLP, Machine Learning, or a related field, complemented by a solid track record in AI R&D (with good publications in A* conferences).

• Experience with PyTorch deep learning frameworks or equivalent frameworks

• Hands-on experience with model quantization including both Quantization-Aware Training (QAT) and Post-Training Quantization (PTQ).

• Research and hands-on experience with knowledge distillation for compressing large models into smaller, efficient ones.

• Research and hands-on experience with model pruning for compressing large models into smaller, efficient ones.

• Solid understanding of neural network architectures and training processes – Including transformers (e.g., LLMs, VLMs), backpropagation, optimization, and fine-tuning techniques.

• Familiarity with C++ is a plus (especially for implementing low-level quantization kernels or inference optimizations).

• Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ tether.to or @ tether.io

• We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Unisciti a Tether e Forma il futuro della finanza digitale
A Tether, non stiamo solo costruendo prodotti, siamo pionieri di una rivoluzione finanziaria globale. Le nostre soluzioni all'avanguardia consentono alle aziende, dagli scambi e dai portafogli ai processori di pagamento e agli sportelli bancomat, di integrare senza soluzione di continuità i gettoni di riserva in blockchains. Imbragando la potenza della tecnologia blockchain, Tether consente di memorizzare, inviare e ricevere i gettoni digitali istantaneamente, in modo sicuro e globale, il tutto ad una frazione del costo. La trasparenza è la base di tutto ciò che facciamo, garantendo fiducia in ogni transazione.

Innovare con Tether
Tether Finance: La nostra innovativa suite di prodotti presenta il più affidabile stablecoin al mondo, USDT , basato su centinaia di milioni di persone in tutto il mondo, insieme ai servizi di tokenizzazione degli asset digitali pionieristici.
Ma questo è solo l’inizio:
Tether Power: Guidare la crescita sostenibile, le nostre soluzioni energetiche ottimizzano l'eccesso di potenza per l'estrazione mineraria di Bitcoin utilizzando pratiche eco-friendly nelle strutture all'avanguardia e geo-diverse.
Tether Data: Riduciamo i costi delle infrastrutture e miglioriamo le comunicazioni globali con soluzioni all'avanguardia come KEET , la nostra app di punta che ridefinisce la condivisione dei dati sicura e privata.
Tether Education: Democratizzazione dell'accesso all'apprendimento digitale di alto livello, forniamo agli individui di prosperare nelle economie digitali e di gig, guidando la crescita globale e l'opportunità.
Tether Evolution: All'incrocio tra tecnologia e potenziale umano, stiamo spingendo i confini di ciò che è possibile, realizzando un futuro in cui innovazione e capacità umane si fondono in modi potenti e senza precedenti.

Perché unirsi a noi?
Il nostro team è una potenza di talento globale, lavorando da remoto da ogni angolo del mondo. Se siete appassionati di fare un segno nello spazio fintech, questa è la vostra opportunità di collaborare con alcune delle menti più brillanti, spingendo i confini e stabilendo nuovi standard. Siamo cresciuti veloci, siamo stati magra, e assicurato il nostro posto come leader nel settore.
Se avete eccellenti capacità di comunicazione inglese e siete pronti a contribuire alla piattaforma più innovativa del pianeta, Tether è il posto per voi.
Sei pronto a far parte del futuro?

Riguardo al lavoro
Come membro del nostro team di ricerca AI, guiderai l'innovazione nella compressione dei modelli e nella distribuzione efficiente dei sistemi AI multimodali avanzati, compresi i modelli di lingua (LLMs) e i modelli di visione (VLMs). Il tuo lavoro si concentrerà sulla riduzione dell'impronta del modello e dei costi computazionali, preservando al contempo l'accuratezza, consentendo all'intelligenza artificiale ad alte prestazioni di eseguire in modo efficiente attraverso i dispositivi di bordo con restrizioni alle risorse. Applicare e avanzare tecniche di compressione come la quantizzazione, la distillazione delle conoscenze e la potatura per semplificare le architetture multimodali complesse che integrano testo, immagini e audio.
Ci aspettiamo di avere una profonda esperienza nei metodi di compressione del modello e un forte background in architetture multimodali modello. Adotterai un approccio pratico e ricercato per sviluppare, testare e implementare nuove strategie di compressione che bilanciano la dimensione del modello, la latenza, il throughput e l'accuratezza. Le tue responsabilità includono la costruzione di robuste tubazioni di compressione, la definizione di metriche di performance e fedeltà, e l'affrontare i colli di bottiglia nell'inferenza di produzione. L'obiettivo finale è quello di fornire sistemi AI scalabili, a bassa memoria, a bassa latenza su dispositivi edge (cioè smartphone) che mantengono alta fedeltà e valore tangibile del mondo reale.

responsabilità
Ripartire le responsabilità chiave nei punti di proiettile. È utile farli agire e misurabili. Questo potrebbe anche essere raggruppato in categorie per ruoli più complessi.

• Applicare la quantizzazione a basso bit per ridurre le dimensioni del modello e la latenza di inferenza per i modelli di AI generativi (LLM, VLM, multimodali) mantenendo la precisione e la qualità di uscita.

• Distillazione delle conoscenze per trasferire le capacità da modelli di insegnanti più grandi a modelli di studenti più piccoli, consentendo un efficiente ragionamento multimodale tra testo, immagine e input audio.

• Implementare tecniche di potatura per rimuovere parametri ridondanti e teste di attenzione, riducendo overhead computazionale senza sacrificare le prestazioni del compito.

• Analizzare i trade-off tra l'efficienza del modello (dimensione, latenza, memoria) e l'accuratezza attraverso metodi di quantizzazione, distillazione e potatura; proporre miglioramenti basati su risultati empirici.

• Ricerca e applicazione di quantizzazione a precisione mista e altre strategie di compressione avanzate (ad esempio, programmi di potatura adattiva, distillazione con caratteristiche intermedie di corrispondenza) per ottimizzare l'equilibrio di precisione-performance.

• Rimani attuale con l'ultima ricerca nella compressione dei modelli, comprese le tecniche emergenti per architetture multimodali e generative.

• Metodologie, esperimenti e risultati dei documenti chiaramente per supportare la riproducibilità, la collaborazione interna e la comunicazione degli stakeholder.

• Autore di documenti tecnici e pubblicare i risultati in conferenze di alto livello (ad esempio, NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, CVPR, ACL, AAAI) per far progredire il campo di compressione del modello per l'IA multimodale.

Elenca le qualifiche, le certificazioni e l'esperienza necessaria per il ruolo. È possibile dividere questo in sezioni obbligatorie e preferite se necessario.

• Una laurea in Informatica o campo correlato. Idealmente PhD in NLP, Machine Learning, o in un campo correlato, completato da un solido track record in AI R&D (con buone pubblicazioni in conferenze A*).

• Esperienza con i quadri di apprendimento profondi di PyTorch o quadri equivalenti

• Esperienza pratica con quantizzazione del modello, inclusi sia Quantization-Aware Training (QAT) che Post-Training Quantization (PTQ).

• Ricerca e esperienza pratica con distillazione della conoscenza per la compressione di grandi modelli in quelli più piccoli ed efficienti.

• Ricerca e esperienza pratica con potatura modello per la compressione di grandi modelli in quelli più piccoli ed efficienti.

• Solida comprensione delle architetture di rete neurali e dei processi di formazione – Compresi trasformatori (ad esempio, LLM, VLM), backpropagazione, ottimizzazione e tecniche di ottimizzazione.

• La familiarità con C++ è un plus (specialmente per l'implementazione di kernel di quantizzazione a basso livello o ottimizzazione delle inferenze).

Informazioni importanti per i candidati
Le truffe di reclutamento sono diventate sempre più comuni. Per proteggersi, si prega di tenere a mente il seguente quando si applica per i ruoli:

• Applicare solo attraverso i nostri canali ufficiali. Non utilizziamo piattaforme o agenzie di terze parti per il reclutamento, a meno che non sia chiaro. Tutti i ruoli aperti sono elencati nella nostra pagina di carriera ufficiale: https://tether.recruitee.com/

• Verificare l’identità del reclutatore. Tutti i nostri reclutatori hanno verificato i profili LinkedIn. Se non sei sicuro, puoi confermare la loro identità controllando il loro profilo o contattandoci attraverso il nostro sito web.

• Siate cauti di metodi di comunicazione insoliti. Non conduciamo interviste su WhatsApp, Telegram o SMS. Tutta la comunicazione avviene tramite e-mail e piattaforme ufficiali.

• Doppio check indirizzi e-mail. Tutte le comunicazioni da noi verranno da e-mail che terminano in @ tether.to o @ tether.io

• Non chiederemo mai il pagamento o i dettagli finanziari. Se qualcuno chiede informazioni finanziarie personali o il pagamento in qualsiasi momento durante il processo di assunzione, è una truffa. Si prega di segnalarlo immediatamente.

Quando in dubbio, non esitate a raggiungere il nostro sito ufficiale.

Treten Sie Tether bei und gestalten Sie die Zukunft der digitalen Finanzen
Bei Tether bauen wir nicht nur Produkte, wir sind Vorreiter einer globalen Finanzrevolution. Unsere innovativen Lösungen ermöglichen es Unternehmen - von Börsen und Wallets bis hin zu Zahlungsprozessoren und Geldautomaten -, reservegestützte Token nahtlos in Blockchains zu integrieren. Durch die Nutzung der Blockchain-Technologie können Sie digitale Token sofort, sicher und global zu einem Bruchteil der Kosten speichern, senden und empfangen. Transparenz ist das Fundament von allem, was wir tun, und gewährleistet das Vertrauen in jede Transaktion.

Innovation mit Tether
Tether Finance: Unsere innovative Produktsuite verfügt über den weltweit vertrauenswürdigsten Stablecoin, USDT, auf den sich Hunderte von Millionen Menschen weltweit verlassen, neben bahnbrechenden Tokenisierungsdiensten für digitale Vermögenswerte.
Aber das ist erst der Anfang:
Tether Power: Unsere Energielösungen, die nachhaltiges Wachstum vorantreiben, optimieren überschüssige Energie für den Bitcoin-Mining mit umweltfreundlichen Praktiken in hochmodernen, geodiversen Anlagen.
Tether Data: Durch die Förderung von Durchbrüchen in der KI und Peer-to-Peer-Technologie senken wir die Infrastrukturkosten und verbessern die globale Kommunikation mit innovativen Lösungen wie KEET, unserer Flaggschiff-App, die den sicheren und privaten Datenaustausch neu definiert.
Tether Education: Indem wir den Zugang zu erstklassigem digitalem Lernen demokratisieren, befähigen wir Einzelpersonen, in den digitalen und Gig-Wirtschaften zu gedeihen und das globale Wachstum und die Chancen zu fördern.
Tether Evolution: An der Schnittstelle von Technologie und menschlichem Potenzial erweitern wir die Grenzen des Möglichen und gestalten eine Zukunft, in der Innovation und menschliche Fähigkeiten auf leistungsstarke, beispiellose Weise verschmelzen.

Warum mitmachen?
Unser Team ist ein globales Talent-Powerhouse, das aus allen Ecken der Welt fern arbeitet. Wenn Sie sich leidenschaftlich für eine Marke im Fintech-Bereich interessieren, ist dies Ihre Gelegenheit, mit einigen der klügsten Köpfe zusammenzuarbeiten, Grenzen zu überschreiten und neue Standards zu setzen. Wir sind schnell gewachsen, sind schlank geblieben und haben uns unseren Platz als Marktführer in der Branche gesichert.
Wenn Sie über ausgezeichnete Englisch-Kommunikationsfähigkeiten verfügen und bereit sind, zur innovativsten Plattform der Welt beizutragen, ist Tether der richtige Ort für Sie.
Bist du bereit, Teil der Zukunft zu sein?

Über den Job
Als Mitglied unseres KI-Forschungsteams treiben Sie Innovationen in der Modellkomprimierung und effizienten Bereitstellung für fortschrittliche multimodale KI-Systeme voran, einschließlich großer Sprachmodelle (LLMs) und Vision-Sprachmodelle (VLMs). Ihre Arbeit wird sich darauf konzentrieren, den Modellfußabdruck und die Rechenkosten zu reduzieren und gleichzeitig die Genauigkeit zu erhalten, sodass Hochleistungs-KI effizient über ressourcenbeschränkte Edge-Geräte laufen kann. Sie werden Kompressionstechniken wie Quantisierung, Wissensdestillation und Beschneiden anwenden und vorantreiben, um komplexe multimodale Architekturen zu optimieren, die Text, Bilder und Audio integrieren.
Wir erwarten von Ihnen fundiertes Fachwissen in Modellkompressionsmethoden und einen starken Hintergrund in multimodalen Modellarchitekturen. Sie werden einen praktischen, forschungsorientierten Ansatz verfolgen, um neuartige Kompressionsstrategien zu entwickeln, zu testen und zu implementieren, die Modellgröße, Latenz, Durchsatz und Genauigkeit ausgleichen. Ihre Aufgaben umfassen den Aufbau robuster Kompressionspipelines, die Festlegung von Leistungs- und Treuemetriken und die Behebung von Engpässen bei der Produktionsschlussfolgerung. Das ultimative Ziel ist es, skalierbare, speicherarme und latenzarme KI-Systeme auf Edge-Geräten (d. H. Smartphones) bereitzustellen, die eine hohe Genauigkeit und einen greifbaren realen Wert beibehalten.

Zuständigkeiten
Aufschlüsselung der wichtigsten Verantwortlichkeiten in Aufzählungspunkten. Es ist hilfreich, sie umsetzbar und messbar zu machen. Dies könnte auch in Kategorien für komplexere Rollen zusammengefasst werden.

• Wenden Sie die Low-Bit-Quantisierung an, um die Modellgröße und die Inferenzlatenz für generative KI-Modelle (LLMs, VLMs, multimodal) zu reduzieren und gleichzeitig die Genauigkeit und Ausgabequalität zu erhalten.

• Nutzen Sie die Wissensdestillation, um Fähigkeiten von größeren Lehrermodellen auf kleinere Schülermodelle zu übertragen, was eine effiziente multimodale Argumentation über Text-, Bild- und Audioeingänge ermöglicht.

• Implementieren Sie Beschneidungstechniken, um redundante Parameter und Aufmerksamkeitsköpfe zu entfernen und den Rechenaufwand zu reduzieren, ohne die Aufgabenleistung zu beeinträchtigen.

• Analysieren Sie Kompromisse zwischen Modelleffizienz (Größe, Latenz, Gedächtnis) und Genauigkeit über Quantisierungs-, Destillations- und Beschneidungsmethoden hinweg; schlagen Sie Verbesserungen basierend auf empirischen Erkenntnissen vor.

• Forschung und Anwendung von Mixed-Präzisions-Quantisierung und anderen fortschrittlichen Kompressionsstrategien (z. B. adaptive Beschneidungspläne, Destillation mit intermediärer Merkmalsanpassung), um die Genauigkeits-Leistungs-Balance zu optimieren.

• Bleiben Sie auf dem Laufenden mit der neuesten Forschung zur Modellkompression, einschließlich neuer Techniken für multimodale und generative Architekturen.

• Dokumentieren Sie Methoden, Experimente und Ergebnisse klar, um Reproduzierbarkeit, interne Zusammenarbeit und Stakeholder-Kommunikation zu unterstützen.

• Autoren technischer Arbeiten und veröffentlichen Ergebnisse in hochkarätigen Konferenzen (z. B. NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, CVPR, ACL, AAAI), um das Gebiet der Modellkompression für multimodale KI voranzutreiben.

Listen Sie die Qualifikationen, Zertifizierungen und Erfahrungen auf, die für die Rolle erforderlich sind. Sie können dies bei Bedarf in obligatorische und bevorzugte Abschnitte aufteilen.

• Ein Abschluss in Informatik oder verwandten Bereich. Idealerweise PhD in NLP, Machine Learning oder einem verwandten Bereich, ergänzt durch eine solide Erfolgsbilanz in AI R & D (mit guten Publikationen in A * Konferenzen).

• Erfahrung mit PyTorch Deep Learning Frameworks oder gleichwertigen Frameworks

• Praktische Erfahrung mit der Modellquantisierung, einschließlich Quantization-Aware Training (QAT) und Post-Training Quantization (PTQ).

• Forschung und praktische Erfahrung mit Wissensdestillation zur Komprimierung großer Modelle in kleinere, effiziente Modelle.

• Forschung und praktische Erfahrung mit dem Modellschnitt zum Komprimieren großer Modelle in kleinere, effiziente Modelle.

• Solides Verständnis von neuronalen Netzwerkarchitekturen und Trainingsprozessen - einschließlich Transformatoren (z. B. LLMs, VLMs), Backpropagation, Optimierung und Feinabstimmungstechniken.

• Die Vertrautheit mit C++ ist ein Plus (insbesondere für die Implementierung von Low-Level-Quantisierungskernels oder Inferenzoptimierungen).

Wichtige Informationen für Kandidaten
Rekrutierungsbetrug ist immer häufiger geworden. Um sich zu schützen, beachten Sie bitte Folgendes, wenn Sie sich für Rollen bewerben:

• Bewerben Sie sich nur über unsere offiziellen Kanäle. Wir verwenden keine Plattformen oder Agenturen von Drittanbietern für die Rekrutierung, es sei denn, dies ist eindeutig angegeben. Alle offenen Rollen sind auf unserer offiziellen Karriereseite aufgeführt: https://tether.recruitee.com/

• Überprüfen Sie die Identität des Recruiters. Alle unsere Recruiter haben LinkedIn-Profile verifiziert. Wenn sie unsicher sind, können sie ihre identität bestätigen, indem sie ihr profil überprüfen oder uns über unsere website kontaktieren.

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Joindre Tether et façonner l'avenir du financement numérique
Chez Tether, nous ne sommes pas seulement des produits de construction, nous sommes pionniers d'une révolution financière mondiale. Nos solutions de pointe permettent aux entreprises – des échanges et des portefeuilles aux processeurs de paiement et aux distributeurs automatiques de billets – d'intégrer de façon transparente les jetons à l'aide de réserves dans toutes les chaînes de blocs. En exploitant la puissance de la technologie blockchain, Tether vous permet de stocker, d'envoyer et de recevoir des jetons numériques instantanément, en toute sécurité et globalement, le tout à une fraction du coût. La transparence est le fondement de tout ce que nous faisons, assurant la confiance dans chaque transaction.

Innover avec Tether
Tether Finance: Notre suite de produits innovants dispose de la plus fiable écurie du monde, USDT, sur laquelle s'appuient des centaines de millions de personnes dans le monde entier, ainsi que des services de tokenisation numériques.
Mais c'est juste le début :
Tether Power: moteur de la croissance durable, nos solutions énergétiques optimisent l'excès de puissance pour l'exploitation minière Bitcoin en utilisant des pratiques écologiques dans des installations géo-diverses à la fine pointe de la technologie.
Tether Data: En alimentant les percées dans l'IA et la technologie pair à pair, nous réduisons les coûts d'infrastructure et améliorons les communications mondiales avec des solutions de pointe comme KEET , notre application phare qui redéfinit le partage de données sécurisé et privé.
Tether Education : Démocratisation de l'accès à l'apprentissage numérique de haut niveau, nous autonomisons les individus à prospérer dans les économies du numérique et des concerts, favorisant la croissance mondiale et les opportunités.
Évolution de l'enseignement : À l'intersection de la technologie et du potentiel humain, nous repoussons les limites de ce qui est possible, écrivant un avenir où l'innovation et les capacités humaines fusionnent de manière puissante et sans précédent.

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?
Notre équipe est une puissance mondiale de talent, travaillant à distance de tous les coins du monde. Si vous êtes passionné par la marque dans l'espace fintech, c'est l'occasion de collaborer avec certains des esprits les plus brillants, de repousser les frontières et de fixer de nouvelles normes. Nous avons grandi rapidement, sommes restés maigres et nous avons obtenu notre place de leader dans l'industrie.
Si vous avez d'excellentes compétences en communication anglaise et êtes prêt à contribuer à la plateforme la plus innovante de la planète, Tether est l'endroit pour vous.
Êtes-vous prêt à faire partie du futur ?

Sur le travail
En tant que membre de notre équipe de recherche sur l'IA, vous piloterez l'innovation dans la compression des modèles et le déploiement efficace pour les systèmes d'IA multimodaux avancés, y compris les grands modèles de langage (LLM) et les modèles de langage de vision (VLM). Votre travail se concentrera sur la réduction de l'empreinte du modèle et des coûts de calcul tout en préservant la précision, permettant à l'IA haute performance de fonctionner efficacement sur les périphériques de bord à ressources limitées. Vous appliquerez et avancerez des techniques de compression telles que la quantification, la distillation des connaissances et la taille pour rationaliser les architectures multimodales complexes qui intègrent le texte, les images et l'audio.
Nous espérons que vous aurez une expertise approfondie dans les méthodes de compression de modèles et un solide bagage dans les architectures de modèles multimodales. Vous adopterez une approche pratique axée sur la recherche pour développer, tester et mettre en œuvre de nouvelles stratégies de compression qui équilibrent la taille, la latence, le débit et la précision du modèle. Vos responsabilités comprennent la construction de pipelines de compression robustes, l'établissement de mesures de performance et de fidélité et la résolution des goulets d'étranglement dans l'inférence de production. L'objectif ultime est de fournir des systèmes AI évolutifs, à faible mémoire et à faible latence sur les périphériques de bord (c.-à-d. smartphones) qui maintiennent une haute fidélité et une valeur réelle tangible.

Responsabilités
Diminuer les responsabilités clés en points. Il est utile de les rendre réalisables et mesurables. Cela pourrait également être groupé en catégories pour des rôles plus complexes.

• Appliquer une quantification à faible débit pour réduire la taille du modèle et la latence d'inférence pour les modèles générateurs d'IA (LLM, VLM, multimodal) tout en maintenant la précision et la qualité de sortie.

• Tirer parti de la distillation des connaissances pour transférer les capacités des plus grands modèles d'enseignants aux plus petits modèles d'élèves, permettant un raisonnement multimodal efficace à travers le texte, l'image et les entrées audio.

• Mettre en œuvre des techniques de taille pour éliminer les paramètres redondants et les têtes d'attention, en réduisant les frais généraux de calcul sans sacrifier la performance des tâches.

• Analyser les compromis entre l'efficacité du modèle (taille, latence, mémoire) et la précision des méthodes de quantification, de distillation et de taille; proposer des améliorations basées sur des résultats empiriques.

• Faire des recherches et appliquer une quantification de précision mixte et d'autres stratégies de compression avancées (p. ex. calendriers d'élagage adaptatifs, distillation avec correspondance intermédiaire) pour optimiser l'équilibre précision-performance.

• Restez à jour avec les dernières recherches sur la compression des modèles, y compris les techniques émergentes pour les architectures multimodales et génératrices.

• Documenter clairement les méthodologies, les expériences et les résultats pour appuyer la reproductibilité, la collaboration interne et la communication avec les intervenants.

• Auteur d'articles techniques et publication de conclusions dans des conférences de haut niveau (p. ex., NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, CVPR, ACL, AAAI) pour faire progresser le domaine de la compression de modèles pour l'IA multimodale.

Énumérez les qualifications, les certifications et l'expérience nécessaires au rôle. Vous pouvez diviser cela en sections obligatoires et préférées si nécessaire.

• Diplôme en informatique ou domaine connexe. Idéalement, le doctorat en NLP, en apprentissage automatique ou dans un domaine connexe, complété par une solide expérience en R-D de l'IA (avec de bonnes publications dans des conférences A*).

• Expérience des cadres d'apprentissage en profondeur de PyTorch ou des cadres équivalents

• Expérience pratique de la quantification des modèles, y compris à la fois la Quantization-Aware Training (QAT) et la Quantization post-formation (PTQ).

• Recherche et expérience pratique de la distillation des connaissances pour la compression de grands modèles en modèles plus petits et efficaces.

• Recherche et expérience pratique de la taille des modèles pour la compression de grands modèles en modèles plus petits et efficaces.

• Compréhension solide des architectures de réseau neuronal et des processus de formation – y compris les transformateurs (p. ex., les LLM, les VLM), la rétropropagation, l'optimisation et les techniques de réglage fin.

• La familiarité avec C++ est un plus (surtout pour la mise en œuvre de noyaux de quantification de bas niveau ou des optimisations d'inférence).

Informations importantes pour les candidats
Les escroqueries de recrutement sont devenues de plus en plus fréquentes. Pour vous protéger, veuillez garder à l'esprit ce qui suit au moment de postuler pour des rôles :

• Appliquer uniquement par nos canaux officiels. Nous n'utilisons pas de plates-formes ou d'agences tierces pour le recrutement, sauf indication claire. Tous les rôles ouverts sont énumérés sur notre page officielle des carrières : https://tether.recruitee.com/

• Vérifiez l'identité du recruteur. Tous nos recruteurs ont vérifié les profils LinkedIn. Si vous n'êtes pas sûr, vous pouvez confirmer leur identité en vérifiant leur profil ou en nous contactant via notre site Web.

• Méfiez-vous des méthodes de communication inhabituelles. Nous ne menons pas d'entrevues sur WhatsApp, Telegram ou SMS. Toute communication se fait au moyen de courriels et de plateformes officiels de l'entreprise.

• Vérifiez les adresses e-mail. Toute communication de nous viendra de courriels se terminant par @ tether.to ou @ tether.io

• Nous ne demanderons jamais de paiement ou de détails financiers. Si quelqu'un demande des renseignements financiers personnels ou un paiement à tout moment pendant le processus d'embauche, c'est une escroquerie. Veuillez le signaler immédiatement.

En cas de doute, n'hésitez pas à contacter notre site officiel.

jobs.description:
Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance
 At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.

Innovate with Tether
 Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT , relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.
 But that’s just the beginning:
 Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.
 Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET , our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.
 Tether Education : Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.
 Tether Evolution : At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

Why Join Us?
 Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.
 If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.
 Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job
 As a member of our AI model team, you will drive innovation in model serving and inference architectures for advanced AI systems. Your work will focus on optimizing model deployment and inference strategies to deliver highly responsive, efficient, and scalable performance across real-world applications. You will work on a wide spectrum of systems, ranging from resource-efficient models designed for limited hardware environments to complex, multi-modal architectures that integrate data such as text, images, and audio.
 We expect you to have deep expertise in designing and optimizing model serving pipelines and inference frameworks as well as a strong background in advanced model architectures. You will adopt a hands-on, research-driven approach to develop, test, and implement novel serving strategies and inference algorithms. Your responsibilities include engineering robust inference pipelines, establishing comprehensive performance metrics, and identifying and resolving bottlenecks in production environments. The ultimate goal is to enable high-throughput, low-latency, low-memory footprint, and scalable AI performance that delivers tangible value in dynamic, real-world scenarios.

Responsibilities

• Design and deploy state-of-the-art model serving architectures that deliver high throughput and low latency while optimizing memory usage. Ensure these pipelines run efficiently across diverse environments, including resource-constrained devices and edge platforms. Establish clear performance targets such as reduced latency, improved token response, and minimized memory footprint.

• Build, run, and monitor controlled inference tests in both simulated and live production environments. Track key performance indicators such as response latency, throughput, memory consumption, and error rates, with special attention to metrics specific to resource-constrained devices. Document iterative results and compare outcomes against established benchmarks to validate performance across platforms.

• Identify and prepare high-quality test datasets and simulation scenarios tailored to real-world deployment challenges, specifically those encountered on low-resource devices. Set measurable criteria to ensure that these resources effectively evaluate model performance, latency, and memory utilization under various operational conditions.

• Analyze computational efficiency and diagnose bottlenecks in the serving pipeline by monitoring both processing and memory metrics. Address issues such as suboptimal batch processing, network delays, and high memory usage to optimize the serving infrastructure for scalability and reliability on resource-constrained systems.

• Work closely with cross-functional teams to integrate optimized serving and inference frameworks into production pipelines designed for edge and on-device applications. Define clear success metrics such as improved real-world performance, low error rates, robust scalability, optimal memory usage and ensure continuous monitoring and iterative refinements for sustained improvements.

• A degree in Computer Science or related field. Ideally PhD in NLP, Machine Learning, or a related field, complemented by a solid track record in AI R&D (with good publications in A* conferences).

• Must have knowledge of Metal Shading Language (MSL). You should be comfortable writing custom compute shaders from scratch.

• Proven experience in low-level kernel optimizations and inference optimization on mobile devices is essential. Your contributions should have led to measurable improvements in inference latency, throughput, and memory footprint for domain-specific applications, particularly on resource-constrained devices and edge platforms.

• A deep understanding of modern model serving architectures and inference optimization techniques is required. This includes state-of-the-art methods for achieving low-latency, high-throughput performance, and efficient memory management in diverse, resource-constrained deployment scenarios.

• Must have strong expertise in writing GPU kernels for mobile devices (i.e., smartphones) as well as a deep understanding of model serving frameworks and engines. Practical experience in developing and deploying end-to-end inference pipelines, from optimizing models for efficient serving to integrating these solutions on resource-constrained devices is required.

• Demonstrated ability to apply empirical research to overcome challenges in model serving, such as latency optimization, computational bottlenecks, and memory constraints. You should be proficient in designing robust evaluation frameworks and iterating on optimization strategies to continuously push the boundaries of inference performance and system efficiency.

• Distributed Inference Systems: Designing and optimizing high-performance inference engines using techniques like Tensor Parallelism, Pipeline Parallelism, and Expert Parallelism to handle massive models on GPU clusters.

• Deep understanding of the math and structure behind Diffusion Models and Vision Transformers

• Understanding of Pruning, Quantization, Flash attention, KV Cache, Speculative Decoding (Eagle) etc.

Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

• Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/

• Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

• Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.

• Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ tether.to or @ tether.io

• We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry. If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you. Are you ready to be part of the future? About the job As a member of our AI model team, you will drive innovation in model serving and inference architectures for advanced AI systems. Your work will focus on optimizing model deployment and inference strategies to deliver highly responsive, efficient, and scalable performance across real-world applications. You will work on a wide spectrum of systems, ranging from resource-efficient models designed for limited hardware environments to complex, multi-modal architectures that integrate data such as text, images, and audio. We expect you to have deep expertise in designing and optimizing model serving pipelines and inference frameworks as well as a strong background in advanced model architectures. You will adopt a hands-on, research-driven approach to develop, test, and implement novel serving strategies and inference algorithms. Your responsibilities include engineering robust inference pipelines, establishing comprehensive performance metrics, and identifying and resolving bottlenecks in production environments. The ultimate goal is to enable high-throughput, low-latency, low-memory footprint, and scalable AI performance that delivers tangible value in dynamic, real-world scenarios. Responsibilities
• Design and deploy state-of-the-art model serving architectures that deliver high throughput and low latency while optimizing memory usage. Ensure these pipelines run efficiently across diverse environments, including resource-constrained devices and edge platforms. Establish clear performance targets such as reduced latency, improved token response, and minimized memory footprint.
• Build, run, and monitor controlled inference tests in both simulated and live production environments. Track key performance indicators such as response latency, throughput, memory consumption, and error rates, with special attention to metrics specific to resource-constrained devices. Document iterative results and compare outcomes against established benchmarks to validate performance across platforms.
• Identify and prepare high-quality test datasets and simulation scenarios tailored to real-world deployment challenges, specifically those encountered on low-resource devices. Set measurable criteria to ensure that these resources effectively evaluate model performance, latency, and memory utilization under various operational conditions.
• Analyze computational efficiency and diagnose bottlenecks in the serving pipeline by monitoring both processing and memory metrics. Address issues such as suboptimal batch processing, network delays, and high memory usage to optimize the serving infrastructure for scalability and reliability on resource-constrained systems.
• Work closely with cross-functional teams to integrate optimized serving and inference frameworks into production pipelines designed for edge and on-device applications. Define clear success metrics such as improved real-world performance, low error rates, robust scalability, optimal memory usage and ensure continuous monitoring and iterative refinements for sustained improvements.
• A degree in Computer Science or related field. Ideally PhD in NLP, Machine Learning, or a related field, complemented by a solid track record in AI R&D (with good publications in A* conferences).
• Must have knowledge of Metal Shading Language (MSL). You should be comfortable writing custom compute shaders from scratch.
• Proven experience in low-level kernel optimizations and inference optimization on mobile devices is essential. Your contributions should have led to measurable improvements in inference latency, throughput, and memory footprint for domain-specific applications, particularly on resource-constrained devices and edge platforms.
• A deep understanding of modern model serving architectures and inference optimization techniques is required. This includes state-of-the-art methods for achieving low-latency, high-throughput performance, and efficient memory management in diverse, resource-constrained deployment scenarios.
• Must have strong expertise in writing GPU kernels for mobile devices (i.e., smartphones) as well as a deep understanding of model serving frameworks and engines. Practical experience in developing and deploying end-to-end inference pipelines, from optimizing models for efficient serving to integrating these solutions on resource-constrained devices is required.
• Demonstrated ability to apply empirical research to overcome challenges in model serving, such as latency optimization, computational bottlenecks, and memory constraints. You should be proficient in designing robust evaluation frameworks and iterating on optimization strategies to continuously push the boundaries of inference performance and system efficiency.
• Distributed Inference Systems: Designing and optimizing high-performance inference engines using techniques like Tensor Parallelism, Pipeline Parallelism, and Expert Parallelism to handle massive models on GPU clusters.
• Deep understanding of the math and structure behind Diffusion Models and Vision Transformers
• Understanding of Pruning, Quantization, Flash attention, KV Cache, Speculative Decoding (Eagle) etc. Important information for candidates Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:
• Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/
• Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.
• Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.
• Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ tether.to or @ tether.io
• We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately. When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Unisciti a Tether e Forma il futuro della finanza digitale
A Tether, non stiamo solo costruendo prodotti, siamo pionieri di una rivoluzione finanziaria globale. Le nostre soluzioni all'avanguardia consentono alle aziende, dagli scambi e dai portafogli ai processori di pagamento e agli sportelli bancomat, di integrare senza soluzione di continuità i gettoni di riserva in blockchains. Imbragando la potenza della tecnologia blockchain, Tether consente di memorizzare, inviare e ricevere gettoni digitali istantaneamente, in modo sicuro e globale, il tutto ad una frazione del costo. La trasparenza è la base di tutto ciò che facciamo, garantendo fiducia in ogni transazione.

Innovare con Tether
Tether Finance: La nostra innovativa suite di prodotti presenta il più affidabile stablecoin al mondo, USDT , basato su centinaia di milioni di persone in tutto il mondo, insieme ai servizi di tokenizzazione degli asset digitali pionieristici.
Ma questo è solo l’inizio:
Tether Power: Guidare la crescita sostenibile, le nostre soluzioni energetiche ottimizzano l'eccesso di potenza per l'estrazione mineraria di Bitcoin utilizzando pratiche eco-friendly nelle strutture all'avanguardia e geo-diverse.
Tether Data: Riduciamo i costi delle infrastrutture e miglioriamo le comunicazioni globali con soluzioni all'avanguardia come KEET , la nostra app di punta che ridefinisce la condivisione dei dati sicura e privata.
Tether Education: Democratizzazione dell'accesso all'apprendimento digitale di alto livello, forniamo agli individui di prosperare nelle economie digitali e di gig, guidando la crescita globale e l'opportunità.
Tether Evolution: All'incrocio tra tecnologia e potenziale umano, stiamo spingendo i confini di ciò che è possibile, realizzando un futuro in cui innovazione e capacità umane si fondono in modi potenti e senza precedenti.

Perché unirsi a noi?
Il nostro team è una potenza di talento globale, lavorando da remoto da ogni angolo del mondo. Se siete appassionati di fare un segno nello spazio fintech, questa è la vostra opportunità di collaborare con alcune delle menti più brillanti, spingendo i confini e stabilendo nuovi standard. Siamo cresciuti veloci, siamo stati magra, e assicurato il nostro posto come leader nel settore.
Se avete eccellenti capacità di comunicazione inglese e siete pronti a contribuire alla piattaforma più innovativa del pianeta, Tether è il posto per voi.
Sei pronto a far parte del futuro?

Riguardo al lavoro
Partecipa al nostro team Finance: The Operations Associate/Senior Associate supporterà le operazioni quotidiane di una piattaforma multi-asset di investimento e tesoreria, con responsabilità che spaziano dalle operazioni commerciali, dalle conciliazioni, dai flussi di attività digitali e dall'automazione dei processi. Il ruolo richiede un individuo altamente orientato ai dettagli con una forte capacità tecnica e un'esperienza operativa in ambienti di mercati finanziari veloci.

responsabilità
● Gestire le conferme commerciali, gli insediamenti e gli eventi del ciclo di vita in più classi di asset.
● supervisionare i processi operativi di portafoglio, custodia e asset digitali.
● Eseguire la prenotazione quotidiana e la riconciliazione di posizioni di titoli, saldi di cassa e P&L attraverso sistemi interni.
● Indaga e risolvi le interruzioni commerciali, i problemi di insediamento e le discrepanze operative con controparti e custodi.
● Supporta i controlli operativi relativi alle attività di tesoreria, trading e asset digitali.
● Assist con le richieste di audit, le conferme e la documentazione di supporto.
● Preparare report operativi giornalieri, settimanali e mensili.
● Costruire, migliorare e mantenere flussi di lavoro operativi, strumenti interni e processi di automazione.
● Identificare opportunità di ottimizzazione dei processi e scalabilità operativa.
● Creare e mantenere la documentazione tecnica, le procedure e le guide degli utenti.
● Assicurare l'adesione a controlli interni, politiche e requisiti normativi applicabili.

Preferiti qualifiche/requisiti:
● Laurea in finanza, contabilità o campo relativo.
● 5+ anni di esperienza operativa preferibilmente presso un fondo di copertura di credito o una società di gestione patrimoniale
● esperienza in beni digitali o ecosistema blockchain (buono da avere ma non obbligatorio)
● Proficienza nel sistema di gestione del portafoglio Enfusion (non obbligatorio)
● Proficienza in Excel + VBA / Python
● abilità analitiche e problem solving eccezionali.
● Ottima attenzione ai dettagli e capacità di comunicazione.
● Forte comprensione dei cicli di vita commerciali e processi di insediamento.
● Ore lavorative: (New York ore): Tra 14H00-10H00 UK tempo(obbligatorio)

Informazioni importanti per i candidati
Le truffe di reclutamento sono diventate sempre più comuni. Per proteggere se stessi, si prega di tenere a mente il seguente quando si applica per i ruoli:

• Applicare solo attraverso i nostri canali ufficiali. Non utilizziamo piattaforme o agenzie di terze parti per il reclutamento, a meno che non sia chiaro. Tutti i ruoli aperti sono elencati nella nostra pagina di carriera ufficiale: https://tether.recruitee.com/

• Verificare l’identità del reclutatore. Tutti i nostri reclutatori hanno verificato i profili LinkedIn. Se non sei sicuro, puoi confermare la loro identità controllando il loro profilo o contattandoci attraverso il nostro sito web.

• Siate cauti di metodi di comunicazione insoliti. Non conduciamo interviste su WhatsApp, Telegram o SMS. Tutta la comunicazione avviene tramite e-mail e piattaforme aziendali ufficiali.

• Doppio check indirizzi e-mail. Tutte le comunicazioni da noi verranno da e-mail che terminano in @ tether.to o @ tether.io

• Non chiederemo mai il pagamento o i dettagli finanziari. Se qualcuno chiede informazioni finanziarie personali o il pagamento in qualsiasi momento durante il processo di assunzione, è una truffa. Si prega di segnalarlo immediatamente.

Quando in dubbio, non esitate a raggiungere il nostro sito ufficiale.

Tether Evolution: An der Schnittstelle von Technologie und menschlichem Potenzial erweitern wir die Grenzen des Möglichen und gestalten eine Zukunft, in der Innovation und menschliche Fähigkeiten auf kraftvolle, beispiellose Weise verschmelzen.

Warum mitmachen?
Unser Team ist ein globales Talent-Powerhouse, das aus allen Ecken der Welt fern arbeitet. Wenn Sie sich leidenschaftlich für eine Marke im Fintech-Bereich interessieren, ist dies Ihre Gelegenheit, mit einigen der klügsten Köpfe zusammenzuarbeiten, Grenzen zu überschreiten und neue Standards zu setzen. Wir sind schnell gewachsen, sind schlank geblieben und haben uns unseren Platz als Marktführer in der Branche gesichert.
Wenn Sie über ausgezeichnete Englisch-Kommunikationsfähigkeiten verfügen und bereit sind, zur innovativsten Plattform der Welt beizutragen, ist Tether der richtige Ort für Sie.
Bist du bereit, Teil der Zukunft zu sein?

Über den Job
Werden Sie Teil unseres Finanzteams: Der Operations Associate / Senior Associate unterstützt den täglichen Betrieb einer Multi-Asset-Investment- und Treasury-Plattform mit Zuständigkeiten für Handelsoperationen, Abstimmungen, Workflows für digitale Vermögenswerte und Prozessautomatisierung. Die Rolle erfordert eine sehr detailorientierte Person mit starken technischen Fähigkeiten und Erfahrung in schnelllebigen Finanzmarktumgebungen.

Zuständigkeiten
Verwalten Sie Handelsbestätigungen, Abwicklungen und Lebenszyklusereignisse über mehrere Anlageklassen hinweg.
Überwachen Sie die operativen Prozesse von Wallet, Depotbanken und Digital Assets.
Tägliche Buchung und Abgleich von Wertpapierpositionen, Barguthaben und P&L in internen Systemen.
Untersuchen und Beheben von Handelsunterbrechungen, Abwicklungsproblemen und operativen Diskrepanzen mit Gegenparteien und Depotbanken.
Unterstützung der operativen Kontrollen in Bezug auf Treasury-, Handels- und Digital Asset-Aktivitäten.
● Unterstützung bei Auditanfragen, Bestätigungen und unterstützender Dokumentation.
Bereiten Sie tägliche, wöchentliche und monatliche Betriebsberichte vor.
Erstellen, Verbessern und Pflegen von operativen Workflows, internen Tools und Automatisierungsprozessen.
● Identifizieren Sie Möglichkeiten zur Prozessoptimierung und betrieblichen Skalierbarkeit.
● Erstellen und pflegen Sie technische Dokumentation, Verfahren und Benutzerhandbücher.
● Gewährleistung der Einhaltung interner Kontrollen, Richtlinien und geltender regulatorischer Anforderungen.

Bevorzugte Qualifikationen/Anforderungen:
● Bachelor-Abschluss in Finanzen, Rechnungswesen oder verwandten Bereich.
● 5+ Jahre Betriebserfahrung vorzugsweise bei einem Credit Hedge Fund oder einer Vermögensverwaltungsgesellschaft
● Erfahrung in digitalen Assets oder Blockchain-Ökosystem(gut zu haben, aber nicht obligatorisch)
● Kenntnisse im Enfusion Portfolio Management System (nicht obligatorisch)
● Kenntnisse in Excel + VBA / Python
● Außergewöhnliche analytische und Problemlösungsfähigkeiten.
● Ausgezeichnete Aufmerksamkeit für Details und Kommunikationsfähigkeiten.
Ein starkes Verständnis der Handelslebenszyklen und Abwicklungsprozesse.
● Arbeitszeit: (New Yorker Stunden): Zwischen 14H00-10H00 UK Zeit (obligatorisch)

Wichtige Informationen für Kandidaten
Rekrutierungsbetrug ist immer häufiger geworden. Um sich zu schützen, beachten Sie bitte Folgendes, wenn Sie sich für Rollen bewerben:

• Bewerben Sie sich nur über unsere offiziellen Kanäle. Wir verwenden keine Plattformen oder Agenturen von Drittanbietern für die Rekrutierung, es sei denn, dies ist eindeutig angegeben. Alle offenen Rollen sind auf unserer offiziellen Karriereseite aufgeführt: https://tether.recruitee.com/

• Überprüfen Sie die Identität des Recruiters. Alle unsere Recruiter haben LinkedIn-Profile verifiziert. Wenn sie unsicher sind, können sie ihre identität bestätigen, indem sie ihr profil überprüfen oder uns über unsere website kontaktieren.

• Seien Sie vorsichtig bei ungewöhnlichen Kommunikationsmethoden. Wir führen keine Interviews über WhatsApp, Telegram oder SMS. Die gesamte Kommunikation erfolgt über offizielle Firmen-E-Mails und Plattformen.

• Überprüfen Sie die E-Mail-Adressen. Die gesamte Kommunikation von uns erfolgt über E-Mails, die auf @ tether.to oder @ tether.io enden.

• Wir werden niemals Zahlungen oder finanzielle Details verlangen. Wenn jemand zu irgendeinem Zeitpunkt während des Einstellungsprozesses nach persönlichen Finanzinformationen oder Zahlungen fragt, ist dies ein Betrug. Bitte melden Sie es sofort.

Fühlen Sie sich im Zweifelsfall frei, über unsere offizielle Website zu erreichen.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Joindre Tether et façonner l'avenir du financement numérique
Chez Tether, nous ne sommes pas seulement des produits de construction, nous sommes pionniers d'une révolution financière mondiale. Nos solutions de pointe permettent aux entreprises – des échanges et des portefeuilles aux processeurs de paiement et aux distributeurs automatiques de billets – d'intégrer de façon transparente les jetons à l'aide de réserves dans toutes les chaînes de blocs. En exploitant la puissance de la technologie blockchain, Tether vous permet de stocker, d'envoyer et de recevoir des jetons numériques instantanément, en toute sécurité et globalement, le tout à une fraction du coût. La transparence est le fondement de tout ce que nous faisons, assurant la confiance dans chaque transaction.

Innover avec Tether
Tether Finance: Notre suite de produits innovants dispose de la plus fiable écurie du monde, USDT, sur laquelle s'appuient des centaines de millions de monde entier, ainsi que des services de tokenisation numériques pionniers.
Mais c'est juste le début :
Tether Power: moteur de la croissance durable, nos solutions énergétiques optimisent l'excès de puissance pour l'exploitation minière Bitcoin en utilisant des pratiques écologiques dans des installations géo-diverses à la fine pointe de la technologie.
Tether Data: En alimentant les percées dans l'IA et la technologie pair à pair, nous réduisons les coûts d'infrastructure et améliorons les communications mondiales avec des solutions de pointe comme KEET , notre application phare qui redéfinit le partage de données sécurisé et privé.
Tether Education : Démocratisation de l'accès à l'apprentissage numérique de haut niveau, nous autonomisons les individus à prospérer dans les économies du numérique et des concerts, favorisant la croissance mondiale et les opportunités.
Évolution de l'enseignement : À l'intersection de la technologie et du potentiel humain, nous repoussons les limites de ce qui est possible, écrivant un avenir où l'innovation et les capacités humaines fusionnent de manière puissante et sans précédent.

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?
Notre équipe est une puissance mondiale de talent, travaillant à distance de tous les coins du monde. Si vous êtes passionné par la marque dans l'espace fintech, c'est l'occasion de collaborer avec certains des esprits les plus brillants, de repousser les frontières et de fixer de nouvelles normes. Nous avons grandi rapidement, sommes restés maigres et nous avons obtenu notre place de leader dans l'industrie.
Si vous avez d'excellentes compétences en communication anglaise et êtes prêt à contribuer à la plateforme la plus innovante de la planète, Tether est l'endroit pour vous.
Êtes-vous prêt à faire partie du futur ?

Sur le travail
Faites partie de notre équipe de finance: L'associé opérationnel/associé principal soutiendra les opérations quotidiennes d'une plateforme d'investissement et de trésorerie multi-actifs, avec des responsabilités couvrant les opérations commerciales, les rapprochements, les flux de travail des actifs numériques et l'automatisation des processus. Ce rôle exige un individu hautement axé sur les détails, doté d'une forte capacité technique et d'une solide expérience dans des environnements de marchés financiers à rythme rapide.

Responsabilités
● Gérer les confirmations commerciales, les règlements et les événements liés au cycle de vie dans plusieurs classes d'actifs.
● Surveiller les processus opérationnels relatifs au portefeuille, au dépositaire et aux actifs numériques.
● Effectuer la réservation et le rapprochement quotidiens des positions de valeurs mobilières, des soldes de trésorerie et des P&L dans tous les systèmes internes.
∙ Enquêter sur les ruptures commerciales, les problèmes de règlement et les divergences opérationnelles avec les contreparties et les dépositaires et les résoudre.
● Appuyer les contrôles opérationnels liés aux activités de trésorerie, de négociation et d'actifs numériques.
● Aider à répondre aux demandes de vérification, aux confirmations et aux documents justificatifs.
● Préparer des rapports opérationnels quotidiens, hebdomadaires et mensuels.
● Construire, améliorer et maintenir les flux de travail opérationnels, les outils internes et les processus d'automatisation.
● Identifier les possibilités d'optimisation des processus et d'évolutivité opérationnelle.
● Créer et tenir à jour la documentation technique, les procédures et les guides d'utilisation.
● Veiller au respect des contrôles internes, des politiques et des exigences réglementaires applicables.

Titres/exigences préférés :
● Baccalauréat en finance, comptabilité ou domaine connexe.
● 5 ans et plus d'expérience opérationnelle de préférence dans un fonds de couverture de crédit ou une société de gestion d'actifs
● expérience dans les actifs numériques ou l'écosystème de blockchain (bien d'avoir mais pas obligatoire)
● Compétence du système de gestion de portefeuille d'Enfusion (non obligatoire)
● Compétence en Excel + VBA / Python
● Capacités exceptionnelles d'analyse et de résolution de problèmes.
● Excellente attention aux détails et aux compétences en communication.
● Une bonne compréhension du cycle de vie du commerce et des processus de règlement.
● Heures de travail: (heures de New York): Entre 14H00-10H00 heure du Royaume-Uni (obligatoire)

Informations importantes pour les candidats
Les escroqueries de recrutement sont devenues de plus en plus fréquentes. Pour vous protéger, veuillez garder à l'esprit ce qui suit au moment de postuler pour des rôles :

• Appliquer uniquement par nos canaux officiels. Nous n'utilisons pas de plates-formes ou d'agences tierces pour le recrutement, sauf indication claire. Tous les rôles ouverts sont énumérés sur notre page officielle des carrières : https://tether.recruitee.com/

• Vérifiez l'identité du recruteur. Tous nos recruteurs ont vérifié les profils LinkedIn. Si vous n'êtes pas sûr, vous pouvez confirmer leur identité en vérifiant leur profil ou en nous contactant via notre site Web.

• Méfiez-vous des méthodes de communication inhabituelles. Nous ne menons pas d'entrevues sur WhatsApp, Telegram ou SMS. Toute communication se fait par l'intermédiaire de courriels et de plateformes officiels de l'entreprise.

• Vérifiez les adresses e-mail. Toute communication de nous viendra de courriels se terminant par @ tether.to ou @ tether.io

• Nous ne demanderons jamais de paiement ou de détails financiers. Si quelqu'un demande des renseignements financiers personnels ou un paiement à tout moment pendant le processus d'embauche, c'est une escroquerie. Veuillez le signaler immédiatement.

En cas de doute, n'hésitez pas à contacter notre site officiel.

jobs.description:
Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance
 At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.

Innovate with Tether
 Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT , relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.
 But that’s just the beginning:
 Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.
 Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET , our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.
 Tether Education : Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.
 Tether Evolution : At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

Why Join Us?
 Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.
 If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.
 Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job
 We are looking for a precision-driven Global Events Financial Controller to serve as the fiscal engine of our Global Events department. In this role, you will be the primary lead for the entire financial lifecycle of our international events—from the first vendor quotation to the final payment and yearly budget reconciliation.

Responsibilities

• Consolidate quotations

• Elaborate budgets, tracking and reports and real-time financial clarity to the Events Team

• Contracts signature process

• Invoicing and payment process

• Multi-currency & multi-company reconciliations

• Post events reports

Requirements

• Bachelor’s Degree in Finance, Accounting, or Business Administration.

• 5+ years of experience in accounting of Events, Travel, or Hospitality industry.

• Advanced Excel skills (VLOOKUPs, Pivot Tables) and Power Point.

• Language: Full professional proficiency or Native in English & Spanish. Italian is a plus.

• Soft Skills: High attention to detail and strong negotiation skills for vendor quotations. Organization skills.

• Some traveling availability might be required

Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

• Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/

• Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

• Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.

• Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ tether.to or @ tether.io

• We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

Unisciti a Tether e Forma il futuro della finanza digitale
A Tether, non stiamo solo costruendo prodotti, siamo pionieri di una rivoluzione finanziaria globale. Le nostre soluzioni all'avanguardia consentono alle aziende, dagli scambi e dai portafogli ai processori di pagamento e agli sportelli bancomat, di integrare senza soluzione di continuità i gettoni di riserva in blockchains. Imbragando la potenza della tecnologia blockchain, Tether consente di memorizzare, inviare e ricevere gettoni digitali istantaneamente, in modo sicuro e globale, il tutto ad una frazione del costo. La trasparenza è la base di tutto ciò che facciamo, garantendo fiducia in ogni transazione.

Innovare con Tether
Tether Finance: La nostra innovativa suite di prodotti presenta il più affidabile stablecoin al mondo, USDT, basato su centinaia di milioni di persone in tutto il mondo, insieme ai servizi di tokenizzazione degli asset digitali.
Ma questo è solo l’inizio:
Tether Power: Guidare la crescita sostenibile, le nostre soluzioni energetiche ottimizzano il potere in eccesso per l'estrazione mineraria di Bitcoin utilizzando pratiche eco-friendly nelle strutture all'avanguardia e geo-diverse.
Data Tether: Riduciamo i costi delle infrastrutture e miglioriamo le comunicazioni globali con soluzioni all'avanguardia come KEET, la nostra app di punta che ridefinisce la condivisione dei dati sicura e privata.
Tether Education: Democratizzazione dell'accesso all'apprendimento digitale di alto livello, forniamo agli individui di prosperare nelle economie digitali e di gig, guidando la crescita globale e l'opportunità.
Tether Evolution: All'incrocio tra tecnologia e potenziale umano, stiamo spingendo i confini di ciò che è possibile, realizzando un futuro in cui innovazione e capacità umane si fondono in modi potenti e senza precedenti.

Perché unirsi a noi?
Il nostro team è una centrale di talento globale, che lavora a distanza da ogni angolo del mondo. Se siete appassionati di fare un segno nello spazio fintech, questa è la vostra opportunità di collaborare con alcune delle menti più brillanti, spingendo i confini e stabilendo nuovi standard. Siamo cresciuti veloci, siamo stati magra, e assicurato il nostro posto come leader nel settore.
Se avete eccellenti capacità di comunicazione inglese e siete pronti a contribuire alla piattaforma più innovativa del pianeta, Tether è il posto per voi.
Sei pronto a far parte del futuro?

Informazioni sul lavoro:
Il Controllore finanziario sovrintenderà alle attività di reporting finanziario, coordinamento di audit e contabilità attraverso una piattaforma di investimento e tesoreria multi-entità. Il ruolo richiede un professionista di finanza tecnicamente forte con una profonda competenza contabile, una forte disciplina operativa, e la capacità di operare in un ambiente veloce e ad alta crescita.

• Preparare dichiarazioni finanziarie accurate e tempestive, conti di gestione e rapporti di supporto in conformità con IFRS e US GAAP.

• Gestisci operazioni contabili quotidiane in più enti e giurisdizioni.

• Superare i processi di fine mese, fine trimestre e fine anno, tra cui le conciliazioni generali di registro e le recensioni di controllo.

• Mantenere la supervisione dei conti pagabili, crediti di conti, accruamenti e riconciliazioni del bilancio.

• Coordinamento di piombo con i revisori esterni, garantendo la consegna tempestiva delle richieste di audit, la documentazione di supporto e la risoluzione dei problemi.

• Preparazione del supporto di eventuali requisiti normativi, fiscali, legali e di reporting ad hoc.

• Rafforzare e mantenere i controlli interni, le politiche contabili e i quadri di governance finanziaria.

• Miglioramento continuo dei processi contabili, dei flussi di lavoro di reporting e dei controlli operativi.

• Leva la tecnologia e l'automazione per migliorare l'efficienza, la scalabilità e la precisione di reporting.

• Collaborare a stretto contatto con le operazioni per garantire l'integrità dei dati finanziari e la reportistica.

• Assistere con implementazione e ottimizzazione dei sistemi finanziari e delle infrastrutture di reporting.

• Sostegno ad hoc analisi finanziaria, progetti e iniziative strategiche come richiesto.

Qualificazioni & Esperienza:

• Laurea in contabilità, finanza, o un campo correlato; ACCA, ACA, CPA, CFA, o certificazioni equivalenti.

• 10+ anni di esperienza nel controllo finanziario, audit o contabilità, preferibilmente in un fondo di copertura di credito. L'esperienza precedente nei beni digitali o negli ecosistemi blockchain è un vantaggio distinto.

• La competenza nel sistema di gestione del portafoglio Xero e Enfusion.

• La competenza in Excel + VBA / Python è obbligatoria.

• Eccezionale capacità analitiche e di problem solving.

• Forte comprensione dei requisiti normativi e fiscali.

• Ottima attenzione ai dettagli e capacità di comunicazione.
